name: What should I do first if I just noticed a small hole or dent in my drywall?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if I just noticed a small hole or dent in my drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small drywall repairs are usually best handled with spackle or joint compound, sanding, and paint touch-up if the damage is just a nail hole, small dent, or hairline crack. If the area is larger, needs texture matching, or shows signs of water damage, a professional repair is the safer choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: For tiny nail holes, dents, and hairline cracks, clean the area, fill it, sand smooth, and repaint. If the damage is larger than a small spot or involves texture or moisture, get a pro to inspect it.
